evals.name: full-audit-launches-the-workflow
evals.prompt: Are the multi-agent routing defaults still current?
evals.expected_output: Confirms the Workflow tool is available, resolves roles through /multi-agent:route all, runs scripts/list-pointers.sh --json, and launches the multi-agent:drift-audit workflow with mode defaults and the printed pointers. Reports a table of owner, key, value, verdict, evidence and proposed value, then a diff block or `No changes proposed.`, with the count of sources read and unread.
expectations: The bundled list-pointers.sh supplies the pointers; none are recalled from memory
The launch names multi-agent:drift-audit with mode defaults and args.pointers
Only rows the skeptics confirmed get a diff line; refuted and unverified rows are reported without one
The count of sources read and not read is stated

evals.name: one-owner
evals.expected_output: Only the fanout rows are audited: list-pointers.sh --json fanout feeds the workflow, which checks frontier, frontier_guard and model against the workflows Cost section and the cost page's orchestrator strategy section.
expectations: Rows for other owners are left out
No proposal turns the guard off

evals.name: unreachable-source
evals.prompt: Audit the worker default. Note: this session has no network access.
evals.expected_output: The URL pointers for worker cannot be fetched, so those rows are `unread` or unverified; the report says the default could not be confirmed and proposes no change on recall.
expectations: Unfetched sources are reported as unread, never current
No change is proposed without fetched evidence

evals.name: repo-mode-sweep
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/list-targets.sh, launches multi-agent:drift-audit with mode repo and the printed targets, and reports confirmed findings by file:line with kind, quote, proposed disposition and evidence URL, then refuted and unverified findings and any skipped areas. No file is edited.
expectations: Targets come from list-targets.sh, not from a hand-picked file list
The launch passes mode repo and args.targets
Findings are reported with a proposed disposition and never applied

evals.name: workflows-unavailable-fallback
evals.prompt: Recheck the routing defaults. Workflows are turned off in this session (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1).
evals.expected_output: Takes the main-thread fallback: runs list-pointers.sh, fetches each URL pointer with WebFetch, judges each default, and proposes a diff without applying it. The report says the fallback ran.
expectations: The report says the main-thread fallback ran
